title: When Hope Feels Far
hook: Hope does not always shout. Sometimes it whispers: not yet, but soon.
prayer: Lord, you know the weight I am carrying right now. When I cannot see how things will turn out, remind me that you are already there, waiting for me in tomorrow.
Plant a small, stubborn hope in my heart. Not a wish, but a quiet trust that you are still writing my story. Amen.
closing: Before you scroll on, name one thing you are still hoping for, and place it in God's hands.
description: A short prayer for the days when hope feels far away. 🌅 Save it for the moment you need it.
